component.name: Connection Dashboard
component.summary: See your desktop, router and internet connection at a glance

description.p: Connection Dashboard shows the state of the three links every networked machine depends on: the desktop itself, the local router and the internet.

It reports the local and public IP addresses, the default gateway, and the Ethernet and Wi-Fi adapter states, then explains the first broken link. Probing runs in the background, so the window opens and stays responsive even with no network connection.
